title: Slot
description: One instrument role in a kit. `id` is the semantic role (kick, snare, hat-closed, hat-open, crash, ride, clap, rim, tom-low, tom-mid, tom-high, then stable named percussion roles), unique per kit.

sampleIds.description: Editorial variant order. Must include defaultSampleId.

chokeGroup.description: v1 convention: both hat slots use "hi-hat"; hat-closed stops older hat-open voices, not vice versa. Other groups have no runtime effect yet.
